meta.title: DEMO ONLY Sheet Practice | Spreadsheet consulting
meta.description: Demonstration site for a fictional independent spreadsheet consultant: spreadsheet cleanup and workflow prototypes, with a three-step workflow.

rationale: Страница строится вокруг одного решения посетителя: какая из двух услуг ему подходит. Поэтому главная кнопка ведёт к описаниям услуг, а затем идёт трёхшаговый порядок работы. Холодный светлый фон, синий сигнальный акцент и гротески дают точный, технический тон без выдуманных панелей и цифр. Векторная таблица в главном экране с подсвеченными одинаковыми строками показывает, что именно находит очистка таблицы.

visualPlan.intent: Понять, что подходит: очистка таблицы или прототип рабочего процесса, и прочитать три шага работы.
visualPlan.layout: Главный экран: заголовок, пояснение и кнопка слева, схема таблицы с подсвеченными дублями справа (на телефоне текст и кнопка идут первыми). Далее две услуги широкими текстовыми разворотами с критерием выбора, затем три шага в ряд и короткая итоговая фраза.

props.headline: Make a messy spreadsheet consistent
props.sub: Independent spreadsheet consulting in two parts: cleaning up a sheet you already have, or building a small working example of a task you repeat by hand.

graphic.label: Abstract spreadsheet with a header row and two identical rows highlighted in blue

props.title: Two services, and how to choose
props.intro: Start with what you have in front of you: a sheet that has drifted, or a task you keep repeating.

items.name: Spreadsheet cleanup
items.description: Choose this when the sheet already exists and has become hard to trust. Names are written one way in one row and another way in the next. Dates are entered in different formats. The same row appears more than once. Cleanup makes names and dates consistent and identifies the duplicate rows, so the whole sheet reads the same way from top to bottom.

items.name: Workflow prototypes
items.description: Choose this when the sheet is fine but one task is repeated by hand, again and again. I build a small working example of that single task, then we discuss it before anything is implemented. You see how it behaves on a sample first, and decide afterwards whether it is worth taking further.

props.title: Three steps from sample to decision

steps.name: Discuss a sample
steps.detail: You share a small sample of the sheet or the task, with anything sensitive taken out. We talk through what repeats and what should change.

steps.name: Review an example
steps.detail: You receive a small working example built on that sample. It covers one repeated task and nothing more, so it is easy to check.

steps.name: Decide what to implement
steps.detail: We discuss the example together. Only then do you decide what, if anything, is worth implementing.
